title: Cổ Học Phương Đông
content_html:
Eastern Classics is an AI-powered digital platform designed to preserve, structure, and explore traditional Eastern knowledge through modern technology.

The platform combines digitized classical texts with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to help users study, compare, and interpret complex philosophical concepts in a structured and interactive way.

Unlike conventional content-based applications that display static information, Eastern Classics leverages AI to dynamically retrieve relevant knowledge sources, understand user context, and generate personalized interpretations grounded in authoritative reference materials.

Key Features

  • Structured Knowledge Repository
    Digitization and organization of classical Eastern knowledge into searchable and interconnected knowledge domains.
  • AI-Powered Interpretation Engine
    Uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to retrieve relevant source materials and generate contextual explanations based on user questions.
  • Context-Aware Analysis
    Applies Large Language Models (LLMs) to analyze relationships between concepts, identify patterns, and provide objective perspectives for learning and research.
  • Interactive Knowledge Exploration
    Multi-turn conversational interface that enables users to ask follow-up questions and progressively deepen their understanding of complex subjects.
  • Research Memory & History Tracking
    Maintains historical interactions, allowing users to revisit previous inquiries, compare interpretations, and build long-term knowledge structures.
  • Modern AI Architecture
    Built on a cloud-based architecture integrating Firebase, AI services, and structured knowledge retrieval to deliver scalable, real-time responses.

Technology Focus

Artificial Intelligence (LLM), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Knowledge Management, Conversational AI, Firebase, Cloud Functions, Mobile Application Development.

title: M2C/B2B2C Ecosystem
content_html:
The M2C Ecosystem is an end-to-end digital commerce framework that bridges the gap between Manufacturers and Consumers by transforming traditional retailers into high-tech Service Hubs. Instead of bypassing the 'mom-and-pop' shops, this model digitizes them to serve as the vital link in the supply chain.

  • Inbound (B2B): Streamlines factory-to-retail distribution using a DMS for real-time visibility and authentic sourcing.
  • Merchant Core: A Super App that empowers shop owners with digital lending (Capital), bill payments (Revenue), and e-invoicing (Operations).
  • Outbound (B2C): Modernizes the storefront with Smart POS payments and digital Loyalty programs to keep consumers engaged.
  • Data Foundation: A CDP-driven base layer that converts every transaction into actionable insights for market prediction and risk management.

title: Little Dizzy - Sliding Puzzle
content_html:

title: What's Interactive E-Commerce?
content_html:
UNA Market – Group Shopping Platform is an innovative e-commerce platform designed to transform the way people shop for food and daily essentials. By integrating group purchasing mechanics, UNA Market empowers customers to enjoy high-quality VietGAP-certified products at significantly reduced prices, while fostering a fun and social shopping experience with friends and family.

Key Highlights

  • Daily Shock Deals: Discounts up to 50% on popular items such as Ri6 durian, pork belly, and Korean strawberries.
  • Group Buying Advantage: Prices at least 20% lower than market rates when purchased in groups.
  • Free Shipping: Available for all orders within Ho Chi Minh City.
  • Quality Assurance: Products meet VietGAP standards, ensuring freshness and safety.
  • Fast Delivery: Orders delivered within 24 hours.

Mission

To eliminate consumer concerns about price and quality in online food shopping, while creating a joyful, community-driven shopping experience.

Tagline

“The more people, the cheaper it gets – shopping made social and fun.”

title: FoodSave App
content_html:
Singapore wastes about 788,600 tonnes of food yearly. Out of this, only 13% is recycled. Singapore spends around $14.8 billion buying food from other countries, yet is one of the top 10 countries in the world with the highest rate of food wastage.

Solutions

An app platform utilizing a sharing economy system that connects B2C and C2C users by integrating food sellers and purchasers, featuring real-time alerts and about-to-expiry notifications on good deals.

Features

  • Merchant Listings: Merchants can list their "before expiry" products in real-time to alert nearby consumers of discount deals.
  • Peer-to-Peer Sharing: Since households contribute significantly to food wastage, users can list their "extra" cooked food or newly purchased items before expiry for nearby users to buy and consume.

title: Delivery Food App
content_html:
Browse local restaurants and fast food favorites for inspiration, or search for a specific restaurant, dish, or cuisine. When you are ready to place your order, you will see your delivery address, an estimated delivery time, and the total price including tax and fees. Track your order in real-time as it heads your way.

Features

  • Your Favorite Restaurants: Choose from a huge variety of cuisines, from your favorite sushi spot to the comfort food you crave.
  • Easy Ordering: Food is just a few taps away. Get your favorite meals faster with quick reordering. Plus, group ordering makes entertaining a breeze.
  • Schedule Deliveries: Advance ordering allows you to get your food when it’s most convenient for you.
  • Real-time Tracking: See when your order will arrive. We factor in food preparation, traffic, and weather.
  • No Minimums: Order as little or as much as you want.
  • Secure Payment: Conveniently pay via Google Pay or credit card.

title: Lunar New Year Gift
content_html: “Banh Tet” is a traditional cake featured in Vietnamese households during Tet holidays. In accordance with old Vietnamese traditions, “Banh Tet” is always present in every home on the first day of the Lunar New Year.

title: Rotating Lamp
content_html: Den Keo Quan (rotating lantern) is a traditional paper toy. In the past, they were popular during Lunar New Year; however, they are now primarily seen during the Mid-Autumn Festival. When the candle inside is lit, the rising hot air causes the inner frame to rotate, casting moving shadow puppets onto the outer paper screen.

title: Wildwest Vietnam
content_html:
A promotional project highlighting the cultures, arts, and travel opportunities within the Mekong Delta provinces.

Known as the 'rice bowl' of Vietnam, the Mekong Delta is carpeted in a dizzying variety of greens. It is a water world that moves to the rhythms of the mighty Mekong, where boats, houses, and markets float upon the innumerable rivers, canals, and streams that criss-cross the landscape like arteries.

The bustling commerce of its towns contrasts sharply with the languid, peaceful pace of life in the countryside. Here, water buffaloes wallow in rice paddies, coconut- and fruit-laden boats float slowly along mud-brown waters, and two-wheeled exploration of narrow lanes is rewarded with a true taste of rural hospitality and delicious local river fish.

Elsewhere, mangrove forests teem with bird life and hold the remnants of historic bunkers, while ornate Khmer pagodas and Buddhist temples reach for the sky, and off-coast islands offer white-sand beaches, tropical hideaways, and historical pirate lore.
